tables.title: Summary of device limitations
tables.text_helper: Table 3, "Summary of device limitations", on page 2 of Rev 5 in section 1 (Summary of device errata).

rows: Unstable LSI when it clocks RTC or CSS on LSE
WUFx wakeup flag wrongly set during configuration
Under Level 1 read protection, booting from main flash memory selected through PA14‑BOOT0 pin is not functional
DMAMUX cannot be synchronized or triggered by EXTI
Overwriting with all zeros a flash memory location previously programmed with all ones fails
Wakeup from Stop not effective under certain conditions
Device lock upon mismatch of option bytes
Corrupted content of the RTC domain due to a missed power-on reset after this domain supply voltage drop
GPIO assigned to DAC cannot be used in output mode when the DAC output is connected to on-chip peripheral
DMA disable failure and error flag omission upon simultaneous transfer error and global flag clear
SOFx not asserted when writing into DMAMUX_CFR register
OFx not asserted for trigger event coinciding with last DMAMUX request
OFx not asserted when writing into DMAMUX_RGCFR register
Wrong input DMA request routed upon specific DMAMUX_CxCR register write coinciding with synchronization event
Overrun flag is not set if EOC reset coincides with new conversion end
Writing ADC_CFGR1 register while ADEN bit is set resets RES[1:0] bitfield
Out-of-threshold value is not detected in AWD1 Single mode
Writing ADC_CFGR2 register while ADEN bit is set resets CKMODE[1:0] bitfield
ADC sampling time might be one cycle longer
ADC offset may be out of specification
Invalid DAC channel analog output if the DAC channel MODE bitfield is programmed before DAC initialization
DMA underrun flag not set when an internal trigger is detected on the clock cycle of the DMA request acknowledge
One-pulse mode trigger not detected in master-slave reset + trigger configuration
Consecutive compare event missed in specific conditions
Output compare clear not working with external counter reset
Bidirectional break mode not working with short pulses
TIM1 and TIM15 synchronization trigger might be missed
TIM16 and TIM17 are unduly clocked by SYSCLK
Device may remain stuck in LPTIM interrupt when entering Stop mode
Device may remain stuck in LPTIM interrupt when clearing event flag
Calendar initialization may fail in case of consecutive INIT mode entry
Tamper flag not set on LSE failure detection
Wrong data sampling when data setup time (t) is shorter than one SU;DAT I2C kernel clock period
Spurious bus error detection in master mode
Spurious master transfer upon own slave address match
OVR flag not set in underrun condition
Transmission stalled after first byte transfer
SDA held low upon SMBus timeout expiry in slave mode
Anticipated end-of-transmission signaling in SPI slave mode
Data corruption due to noisy receive line
Received data may be corrupted upon clearing the ABREN bit
Noise error flag set while ONEBIT is set
Possible LPUART transmitter issue when using low BRR[15:0] value
BSY bit may stay high when SPI is disabled
BSY bit may stay high at the end of data transfer in slave mode
Missed CEC messages in normal receiving mode
Unexpected TXERR flag during a message transmission
TXHRST upon write data underflow corrupting the CRC of the next packet
Ordered set with multiple errors in a single K-code is reported as invalid
UCPD wrong Rpdb default trimming value after power-on

tables.title: Document revision history
tables.text_helper: Table 5, "Document revision history", on page 25 of Rev 5.

rows: Added errata: •DMAMUX cannot be synchronized or triggered by EXTI •Overwriting with all zeros a flash memory location previously programmed with all ones fails •GPIO assigned to DAC cannot be used in output mode when the DAC output is connected to on-chip peripheral •Overrun flag is not set if EOC reset coincides with new conversion end •Writing ADC_CFGR1 register while ADEN bit is set resets RES[1:0] bitfield •Out-of-threshold value is not detected in AWD1 Single mode •TIM1 and TIM15 synchronization trigger might be missed •TIM16 and TIM17 are unduly clocked by SYSCLK •Data corruption due to noisy receive line •USART prescaler feature missing in USART implementation section Added .

Added errata: •Wakeup from Stop not effective under certain conditions •Flash memory PCROP area weakness •PC13 signal transitions disturb LSE •ADC sampling time might be one cycle longer •ADC trigger latency parameter •RNG entropy not guaranteed with Range 2 •Consecutive compare event missed in specific conditions •Output compare clear not working with external counter reset Modified errata: •Device may remain stuck in LPTIM interrupt when entering Stop mode •Device may remain stuck in LPTIM interrupt when clearing event flag

Added Section Important security notice. Added errata: •Boot select after debug interface connection •Corrupted content of the RTC domain due to a missed power-on reset after this domain supply voltage drop Updated Table 2. Device variants. Updated errata: •Overwriting with all zeros a flash memory location previously programmed with all ones fails •Writing ADC_CFGR1 register while ADEN bit is set resets RES[1:0] bitfield •ADC offset may be out of specification •Device may remain stuck in LPTIM interrupt when clearing event flag

Added errata: •System: Device lock upon mismatch of option bytes •ADC: Writing ADC_CFGR2 register while ADEN bit is set resets CKMODE[1:0] bitfield •DAC: Invalid DAC channel analog output if the DAC channel MODE bitfield is programmed before DAC initialization •DMA underrun flag not set when an internal trigger is detected on the clock cycle of the DMA request acknowledge •TIM: Bidirectional break mode not working with short pulses •RTC: Tamper flag not set on LSE failure detection •I2C: START bit is cleared upon setting ADDRCF, not upon address match

•OVR flag not set in underrun condition •Transmission stalled after first byte transfer •SDA held low upon SMBus timeout expiry in slave mode •USART: Anticipated end-of-transmission signaling in SPI slave mode •Received data may be corrupted upon clearing the ABREN bit •Noise error flag set while ONEBIT is set •LPUART: Possible LPUART transmitter issue when using low BRR[15:0] value •CEC: Missed CEC messages in normal receiving mode •Unexpected TXERR flag during a message transmission •UCPD: TXHRST upon write data underflow corrupting the CRC of the next packet •Ordered set with multiple errors in a single K-code is reported as invalid Modified errata: •System: Unstable LSI when it clocks RTC or CSS on LSE (PWRRST flag name) •ADC: ADC offset may be out of specification (workaround: added possibility of using DAC output to provide V internally to the ADC)REF+ •LPTIM: Device may remain stuck in LPTIM interrupt when entering Stop mode •USART: Data corruption due to noisy receive line (workaround now available)
